input.answer: If I have to choose, I'd take the second one, the list grouped by company. I can find one name I've heard of, like Harel or Migdal, and read down its tracks until I reach words I know, like אג"ח and כספי (שקלי). I'm not sure about it, though. All three were too dark and too full of numbers for me, and I'd still ask you or the bank before I put money anywhere.

stuck.why: It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500', English letters and shares, on a black screen full of numbers. I felt straight away that it isn't for me.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the three buttons at the top (1, 2, 3, with 'מומלץ' on the third)
stuck.why: At first I didn't understand that these are three different drawings and that I have to scroll down to see each one.

stuck.where: Screens 2–3, the Harel and Mor lists
stuck.why: Each line has two percentages, a circle, more percentages and 'פחות מ־3 שנים'. My eyes got lost in the middle of the line.
The browns are too close to each other and I couldn't tell which one means expensive. Here I got tired and stopped.

used: The top heading: 'קופת גמל להשקעה: 143 מסלולים של 12 חברות... נתוני רשות שוק ההון'
The company names I know: הראל, מגדל, כלל, הפניקס, מנורה
In the Harel list: 'כספי (שקלי)' 0.57%, 'אג"ח סחיר', and the return 4.25% over 3 years
The fee column 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון' and the sentence 'החיסכון 0.50% עד 0.73%' in option 3
skimmed: The row of small round buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
The small sentences between the drawings that explain each option
skipped: Screen 5, which I didn't reach because I was tired
The 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' link
The orange line with company names at the bottom of screen 4
The column 'חשיפה בסוף ספטמבר 2026' with the circles
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדד, עוקב מדדי מניות, עוקב מדדים - גמיש
the circles with the yellow and turquoise colours
the shades of brown in the table
the number in the 'קופה' column (13874 and so on)
the dashed lines under the numbers
not_found: The word פיקדון, or a comparison with a bank deposit
Something that says plainly which track is safe and can't lose money
A simple sentence saying what the fee means in shekels

findings.what: Black background with grey writing. Many of the small labels are pale and hard to read even when enlarged.
The first option opens with S&P 500 and shares. Someone looking for safe saving leaves at the very first screen.
Too many numbers on every line: two fees, two percentages, a circle, returns and assets. It makes me anxious.
The colours in the table are close browns, and I couldn't tell which means expensive and which cheap.
The safe tracks (כספי, אג"ח) are at the bottom of each company, after the shares, and I almost didn't get to them.
English and words like מט"ח and חשיפה, with no explanation.
findings.where: The track names and the column headings

findings.what: It isn't clear that the three buttons at the top are three separate drawings further down the page.
